column2: Meet Flotilla: your coding agents, side by side, each alone in its own isolated cloud VM.
Start a thread in your repo and say what you want.
It starts in seconds, in a fresh VM of its own, with your repo already set up.
Its dev servers start too, so you can open the app it's building.
When the pull request conflicts, Resolve writes the prompt for the agent.
When the checks go green, hold to merge.
If a commit breaks setup, fix it in a new thread, error and log included.
Four files in dot agents tell Flotilla how to set up, wake, clean up and serve your repo.
Day or night, it feels at home on your Mac.
Flotilla. A fleet of coding agents, each in its own boat.
